tablet.notes: Calls: dragging along the tab row (All, Missed, Received...) only scrolls the row, it no longer swipes to another screen. The same number written with or without +1 is one person in the call history, Message and Quick replies. Voicemail: Refresh can ask the flip phone or the other tablet (Voicemail settings, or hold the Refresh icon).
